parts.name: Coolant warning label · check only on cold engine!
parts.purpose: Identifies the expansion-tank cold-engine check warning on the installed cooling assembly.
facts: IPC 75-20-00 item 11 lists one WARNING LABEL, P/N 897506, for the 912 ULS expansion-tank assembly.
Installed-tank photo shows the tall label on the upper cylindrical wall beside the fitting; the preserved source artwork reads “check only on cold engine!”.
parts.geometryNote: One thin closed shell follows the current expansion-tank exterior by ray-sampling its published GLB surface. The 19 × 38 × 0.18 mm envelope, 0.08 mm adhesion clearance and +X-side clocking are fit estimates from the installed photo and reconstructed 65 mm tank diameter; OEM dimensions, adhesive and exact clocking are unpublished. Original source PNG bytes are retained without redraw; its low-resolution microtext remains a source facsimile.
